CompanyUnitsOfMeasure.title: CompanyUnitsOfMeasure
CompanyUnitsOfMeasure.description:
Scope: enable/disable Units of Measure per company (not the global catalog).

Rule: all transactions must reference the company-enabled list.

Why:

  • Consistent data
  • Valid conversions
  • Regulatory compliance (pharma/logistics/finance)
  • No free-text units
